regulations.notes: San Francisco requires registration with the Office of Short-Term Rentals (OSTR). STRs are limited to the host's primary residence. Unhosted rentals (host not present) are capped at 90 days per year; hosted rentals have no day cap. Application fee as of May 2025 is $925, valid for 2 years. Hosts must carry property-liability insurance of at least $500,000 or use a platform that provides it (e.g., Airbnb, VRBO).
